title: Product-led campaigns: Stocks, IPO, F&O & MTF
deck: The product becomes the story. Turning real app interfaces and trading features into acquisition campaigns across Meta, Google and YouTube.
gallery: Product stories, built for the feed.
challengeTitle: Show the value. Earn the download.
roleTitle: From app feature to acquisition creative.
challenge: Drive app acquisition at scale across Meta and Google with creative that quickly explains what the app does and why it is worth downloading. Real interfaces and trading features needed to make the product benefit immediately clear.
process: • Creative strategy
Translated app features into campaigns for app installs and demat account acquisition, adapting stocks, F&O, MTF and ETF stories to different stages of the user journey.
• Production & compliance coordination
Led development of video ads, coordinated reviews with the compliance team and refined creative in response to feedback. Adapted the work to the aspect ratios required across Meta and Google.
• Continuous optimisation
Partnered with performance marketers to analyse campaign data and iterate on visual hooks, messaging and formats for better click-through and install rates.
outcome: The original campaign documentation reports 2–3% click-through rates and an average of 80K+ app installs per campaign. Realistic UI animations and clear trading-feature demonstrations became a repeatable creative approach for acquisition.

title: Angel One × IPL: Creative at the speed of the game
deck: A full season of cricket-inspired creative, connecting stadium experiences with broadcast, social and performance marketing.
gallery: One season. Many ways to show up.
challengeTitle: Stand out in India’s busiest advertising season.
roleTitle: A lean team. A high-volume creative engine.
outcomeTitle: A national stage for the brand.
challenge: Angel One secured the IPL sponsorship with a tight turnaround window, requiring rapid, high-volume creative execution in India's most competitive advertising environment. The objective was to consistently link the thrill of investing with the high energy of cricket, capturing a younger demographic by fusing the sport with Angel One's core value propositions (RTBs) across the season.
process: • Creative Strategy & Compliance Cordination

Conceptualized the overarching cricket-themed visual language and coordinate with compliance guidelines from SEBI. Designed high-impact, two-liner headlines and scalable master layouts using Adobe Firefly to adapt rapidly for Google and Meta performance ads
• Agile Team Leadership

Directed a continuous, high-velocity production pipeline. Briefed, reviewed, and managed a lean team of graphic and motion designers to deliver daily high-volume output without compromising premium visual quality.
• Experiential & On-Ground LEDs
Produced dynamic in-stadium video content, including perimeter board loops and giant LED visuals engineered to capture attention instantly within a live, high-energy environment.
• Performance Video Library
Built an acquisition-focused library of 50+ video ads adapted across multiple aspect ratios and audience segments to maximize new customer sign-ups during peak viewership.
Production time cut by 40-50% through Gen-AI integration and hit ~1.1B impressions
outcome: Achieved ~1.1 billion impressions across the IPL season. Orchestrated a lean, three-person team to deliver 60+ assets for stadium LEDs, broadcast, and digital channels, driving both aggressive customer acquisition and sustained brand dominance during India's biggest sporting event

title: Pesto: A cinematic product story
deck: Making a complex recruitment platform easy to understand through a carefully choreographed blend of interface animation, 3D and cinematic craft.
gallery: From the viewport to the final frame.
challengeTitle: Make the whole journey feel effortless.
roleTitle: Building the film, layer by layer.
outcomeTitle: A clear demonstration. A premium first impression.
challenge: Create a high-quality demonstration for an AI-powered recruitment platform, communicating the complete user journey while simplifying complex workflows into a concise, engaging experience.
process: • Concept & art direction
Researched the brand and established a minimalist, dark visual language that kept the product interface at the centre of the film.
• 3D animation
Designed tablet animations in Blender and KeyShot, using camera movements and multiple angles to create cinematic B-roll.
• UI animation
Animated the interface and typography from the storyboard, connecting each product step with smooth transitions.
• Compositing
Combined 3D renders, UI motion and effects, then refined sound design, pacing and transitions into the final master.
outcome: Delivered a cinematic master product video for Pesto’s marketing and sales teams. The combination of realistic 3D, interface animation and controlled pacing made the platform journey easier to follow and established a premium visual baseline for its digital channels.

title: MyMuse: A more personal kind of product story
deck: A cohesive visual world for product launches, built through photography, CGI and motion with emotion and considered product design at its centre.
gallery: A visual language for every launch.
challenge: Marketing sexual wellness products in India required navigating strict advertising regulations and platform policies. The challenge was to Launch multiple product categories under one cohesive brand language.
process: • Creative execution

Defined the visual identity for product launches, art direction, and storytelling across digital campaigns. Instead of relying on explicit communication, the creative strategy focused on emotion, design, and premium product storytelling.
• Production Leadership
Managed end-to-end creative production including product shoots, lifestyle photography, CGI renders, motion assets, post-production, and vendor coordination.
• AI-Assisted Go-To-Market (GTM)

Integrated AI image generation into the studio workflow to rapidly accelerate concept exploration and visual iteration. This approach significantly cut down production timelines, delivering premium, conversion-ready assets at scale without compromising brand quality
outcome: Established a consistent premium visual language across product launches, strengthening MyMuse's brand identity and improving product discoverability. A cohesive creative system across photography, video, and CGI assets contributed to stronger customer engagement and supported marketing performance across multiple platforms.

title: A study in time: Cinematic watch films
deck: Turning materials, mechanics and movement into a premium visual experience for watch launches.
gallery: The materials. The mechanics. The detail.
challenge: The client demanded a striking, cinematic narrative that immediately communicates high-end luxury. The core challenge was translating standard product specifications into an emotional, high-status visual language under strict production timelines, requiring flawless alignment across design, technical development, and storytelling.
process: • Visual strategy

Established a high-dynamic rendering (HDR) pipeline, focusing on dramatic high-contrast lighting, deep shadows, and photorealistic textures to emphasize the watch's premium materials and craftsmanship.
• Cross-Disciplinary Leadership

Directed a multi-talented team, guiding the Designer on luxury aesthetics, collaborating with the 3D Developer on complex camera movements and lighting setups, and working with Journalists to ensure the core narrative matched the premium visuals.
• Cinematic Flow
Orchestrated micro-macro camera transitions, using sweeping, slow-motion reveals of the watch mechanics to mimic high-end luxury car and jewelry commercials.
outcome: Delivered a high-end, photorealistic 3D asset that successfully redefined the product's market positioning. The final animation met the client’s strict luxury benchmarks, creating a powerful, cinematic promotional tool optimized for digital flagship displays and high-conversion ad campaigns.

title: Making finance understandable
deck: Audience-first educational films that make financial concepts and trading features easier to follow, from the first hook to the final explanation.
challengeTitle: Simplify the subject. Keep the attention.
roleTitle: From initial brief to final upload.
outcomeTitle: A stronger foundation for organic growth.
challenge: The objective was to make complex financial concepts and trading features easy for a broader audience to understand while working within tight production constraints. Translate complex trading concepts, market terminology, and product features into engaging, easy-to-understand educational videos.
process: • Creative Strategy & Planning

Owned the creative lifecycle from initial brief to final upload. Architected the structural pacing for educational and product-focused content, leveraging audience behavior data to script videos that kept viewers engaged past the critical 30-second drop-off mark
• Post-Production & Execution

Led end-to-end post-production, including editing, motion graphics, transitions, color grading, sound design, and subtitle integration. Maintained a consistent visual identity across all long-form YouTube videos.
• Performance Optimization

Continuously analyzed audience retention graphs and engagement metrics to refine future content. Applied YouTube-specific best practices for thumbnail design (A/B testing visual hooks), title copywriting, and video pacing to maximize organic search discoverability and click-through rates
outcome: Streamlined the entire production workflow from scripting and shooting to editing for consistent content delivery.

The optimized content strategy contributed to 15–20% increase in YouTube subscriber growth during Q2 2025. The improved storytelling, polished production quality, and audience-first editing approach resulted in higher viewer engagement, stronger watch retention, and a more professional, trustworthy brand presence across the channel.

title: Angel One: The Smart Republic
deck: Relatable stories that make investing feel accessible, connecting product benefits with a consistent brand narrative across three flagship films.
challengeTitle: Change the perception of who investing is for.
challenge: Following its rebrand from Angel Broking, Angel One needed to dismantle the perception that stock trading was reserved exclusively for financial experts. The objective was to reposition the platform as intuitive and accessible, reassuring first-time investors that they could start trading quickly and confidently without needing prior market expertise
process: • Agency Collaboration

Partnered with external agency teams and production houses throughout the full creative lifecycle from concept alignment and script/storyboard reviews to on-set art direction and post-production feedback rounds.
• Brand Custodianship

Served as the lead brand guardian across production, enforcing Angel One’s visual identity system (typography, color palettes, tone of voice, and app UI representations) to ensure strict consistency across all three films.
• Cross-Channel Asset Optimization

Collaborated with digital and performance marketing teams to slice, re-frame, and optimize master TVC cuts into high-converting video formats for YouTube, Meta, and Google Display while maintaining visual integrity
outcome: Generated 10M+ combined views across broadcast and digital platforms through three flagship brand films. The campaign significantly boosted brand recall, reinforced core product USPs (Zero Brokerage, Quick Account Opening, Smart Recommendations), and delivered high-converting master assets for downstream performance marketing

title: Banking beyond the branch
deck: Stage environments, sports activations and physical brand experiences for three of India’s leading banks.
gallery: From stage concepts to brand experiences.
challenge: Banking brands operate under strict brand guidelines and high visibility every event, stage, and BTL touchpoint is a direct reflection of the institution's credibility. Delivering 12+ events a year across formats as varied as corporate stage productions, sports activations, and below-the-line campaigns demanded consistent creative quality, fast turnarounds, and zero room for brand inconsistency.
process: • Creative strategy & Design

Designed full stage layouts and production environments for ICICI Bank's corporate events conceptualising the spatial design, backdrop visuals, signage systems, and on-stage brand presence to create a polished, high-impact experience for attendees.
• Sports activation Creatives

Led the creative for HDFC Bank's sports events designing activation environments, fan-facing brand experiences, and all supporting collateral. Balanced the energy of a live sports setting with HDFC's brand language to create activations that felt both exciting and on-brand.
• BTL & Print Media

Produced a high volume of below-the-line and print creative across all three banks standees, hoardings, brochures, event kits, and promotional materials ensuring every piece adhered to individual brand guidelines while meeting tight production deadlines.
outcome: Delivered 12+ events annually across HDFC, ICICI, and Yes Bank spanning stage productions, sports activations, and BTL campaigns. Every project was executed on time, on brand, and to production standard, building long-term creative relationships with some of India's most recognised financial institutions.

title: Toyota × Drum Tao: Beyond the live stage
deck: Translating the energy and precision of a live percussion performance into promotional films and teasers for the India tour.
gallery: The energy of the tour, captured.
challengeTitle: Bring the live experience to a digital audience.
outcomeTitle: Extending the performance beyond the venue.
challenge: Toyota's collaboration with Drum Tao was a bold, culturally rich brand activation built around a live performance tour. The challenge was translating the energy, precision, and spectacle of a live Drum Tao performance into short-form digital content that could build anticipation, drive awareness, and extend the event's reach far beyond the audience in the room all through social media and YouTube.
process: • Promo video production

Produced promotional videos for the Toyota × Drum Tao campaign editing performance footage, brand visuals, and campaign messaging into compelling, high-energy content that captured the fusion of Toyota's brand identity with the raw power of Drum Tao's live show.
• Video films optimization

Managed content distribution across social media and YouTube adapting formats for each platform and coordinating the rollout to maximise reach and amplify the voice of the event throughout the tour season.
outcome: The campaign successfully amplified Toyota's brand association with Drum Tao's live tour extending the event's cultural impact well beyond the performance venues through digital content. The promo videos and teasers helped generate awareness and excitement across social media and YouTube, giving Toyota a distinctive, high-energy creative presence built on a genuinely unique cultural collaboration.
